question: Should OpenClaw add task-level model metadata to HEARTBEAT.md, keep heartbeat routing as whole-turn plugin policy, or design a broader heartbeat task-routing hook/API first?
rationale: Implementation depends on maintainer intent for public HEARTBEAT.md syntax, split-versus-batched model calls, and how task-level overrides compose with provider auth, fallbacks, and session state.

options.title: Design shared routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat/task routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow HEARTBEAT.md task model field with explicit split/group semantics, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
options.body: Document whole-turn before_model_resolve plugins as the supported routing path and explicitly leave multiple due heartbeat tasks un-split for now.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat/task routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses core heartbeat syntax and the existing plugin hook boundary, and steipete has recent history on that product/API seam.
